props.name: Silo 81 surface portal
props.text: Six metres of poured concrete and two blast leaves, one jammed open. Someone scratched SEALED FROM INSIDE into the pier. The door is not sealed now.

props.name: Guard post
props.text: The heater is a block of rust. The duty log stops in the middle of a sentence. The chair is still pulled up to the window.

props.name: Sandbag nest
props.text: Empty. Brass casings frozen into the snow, all pointing outwards.

props.name: Checkpoint barrier
props.text: The boom snapped where it met the post. A child's red mitten is tied to the stump.

props.name: Evacuation notice
props.text: EVACUATION - NEW MERIDIAN - 40 KM. Assemble at the depot. Bring documents, warm clothing, three days of food. The arrow pointing east has been torn half away.

props.name: Perimeter fence
props.text: Chain-link round the portal compound, sagging between its posts.

props.name: Perimeter fence
props.text: Chain-link round the portal compound, sagging between its posts.

props.name: Perimeter fence
props.text: Chain-link, bent outwards. Whatever went through it was leaving.

props.name: Abandoned van
props.text: Doors open, nose to the tail-lights of the car in front. The seats have been cut out for the foam.

props.name: Abandoned car
props.text: A family estate car. Under the snow on the back seat, a shape you decide not to look at closely.

props.name: Abandoned van
props.text: Pushed sideways by the plough, its back wheels in the ditch.

props.name: Abandoned car
props.text: Keys still in. The fuel cap is off and the tank is dry.

props.name: Army truck
props.text: On its side below the road, where it went through the rail. Sandbags, a field radio, jerrycans. No bodies. No tracks leading away, either.

props.name: Army crate
props.text: Stencilled CIVIL DEFENCE - RATIONS. Thrown from the truck's bed. The lid is frozen down and the lead seal is still on it.

props.name: Sandbags
props.text: Spilled from the truck bed in a line. Split, frozen hard as stone.

props.name: Guardrail
props.text: Torn out and bent down the bank where the army truck went over.

props.name: Culvert parapet
props.text: Concrete, with a rail on top. The creek runs under the road here, frozen grey.

props.name: Culvert parapet
props.text: Concrete, with a rail on top. The creek runs under the road here, frozen grey.

props.name: Firewood
props.text: Split pallet wood under a sheet of tin, stacked against the wind. Somebody meant to stay longer.

props.name: Bedroll
props.text: Army blanket over a sack of straw, feet to the fire. Still roughly the shape of a sleeper.

props.name: Bedroll
props.text: Army blanket over a sack of straw, feet to the fire.

props.name: Leaning pylon
props.text: Leaning over the road like it is listening. Scorch marks on the legs and spent cases in the snow under it: people fought here.

props.name: Fallen pylon
props.text: The next pylon down the line, lying where it fell, cables still running back up to its neighbour.

props.name: Air-drop crate
props.text: A military crate, dropped from the air and never collected. Its parachute is snagged on the pylon above, flapping when the wind gets up.

props.name: Stalled car
props.text: Stopped in its lane, doors open, engine cold for years. A suitcase on the back seat, a child's seat, a road map with New Meridian circled in pencil.

props.name: Shape in the snow
props.text: At the end of the drag mark. A rucksack strap sticks up out of the drift, and a boot. You'd have to dig.

props.name: Jack-knifed trailer
props.text: BALTIC FREIGHT, faded to pink. It jack-knifed pulling in for fuel. The back doors were cut open with a torch. Empty, apart from frost.

props.name: Rest stop kiosk
props.text: Shelves stripped to the brackets. A kettle on a cold stove. A radio on the counter, its battery long dead, still tuned to the emergency band.

props.name: Fuel pump
props.text: NO FUEL, says the sign. The hose has been cut for the rubber.

props.name: Snowed-in car
props.text: Parked square in the bay, the only tidy thing here. A photo tucked in the sun visor: three people squinting into summer.

props.name: Billboard
props.text: NEW MERIDIAN 40 km - EVACUATION ROUTE. Someone has painted a line of marks under it, one for each day, until they stopped.

props.name: Burned bus
props.text: Burned from the inside. The seats are springs.

props.name: Scrapped van
props.text: Stripped down to the frame. Its doors are in the town wall now.

props.name: Graves
props.text: A row of five, facing the road. Crosses of exhaust pipe and fence post, hubcaps for headstones. Number plates for names.

props.name: Strongbox
props.text: Thrown clear of the bus, blackened by the fire. Somebody went at the lock with a crowbar and gave up. Whatever is inside is still inside.

props.name: Junk Town wall
props.text: Wrecks nose to tail, propped and chained, fence panels in the gaps.

props.name: Junk Town wall
props.text: A Zhiguli on its belly, chained to a post. Plates nailed along it: names, dates. A memorial of the road.

props.name: Junk Town gate
props.text: Truck-box doors on rails, open by day. Somebody up on the towers is always watching the road.

props.name: Gate leaf
props.text: A gate leaf of planks and sheet on a rail, pulled open.

props.name: Gate leaf

props.name: Gate tower
props.text: A rifleman's platform of scaffold and planks. The guard up there nods at you, rifle across his knees.

props.name: Bunkhouse
props.text: Bunks for travellers who reach the gate after dark. Two blankets each, and a rule about boots.

props.name: Clinic
props.text: A cot, a lamp, boiled rags on a line. The medic is out, but the kettle is warm.

props.name: Smokehouse
props.text: Goat, mostly. The smell carries to the gate.

props.name: Mara's garage
props.text: Half workshop, half home: a vice, a parts shelf, a stove that never goes out, and an engine block on a stand.

props.name: Market shack
props.text: Tin roof, salvaged counter, and a hand-painted sign: BUY - SELL - SWAP. Ammunition by the round.

props.name: Water store
props.text: Barrels of meltwater, boiled and counted. The cistern is padlocked twice.

props.name: Washing line
props.text: Shirts, a blanket, socks frozen stiff. Somebody here still does laundry.

props.name: Car on blocks
props.text: Mara's project. Half its parts are in the wall already.

props.name: Burn barrel
props.text: Somebody always keeps it lit. People stand round it to trade news.

props.name: Market stall
props.text: Jars of rendered fat, valve washers, a radio that works if you hit it.

props.name: Market stall
props.text: Boots, coats, gloves: none of them new, all of them dry.

props.name: Market stall
props.text: Dried mushrooms, salt, a jar of something red.

props.name: Notice board
props.text: WORK: wall repair, pays in food. LOST: grey dog, answers to Kopek. CONVOY TO NEW MERIDIAN - SUSPENDED - ASK MARA.

props.name: Goat pen
props.text: Three goats, a trough and a hay pile. The settlement's milk.

props.name: Tea house
props.text: A stove, a samovar, six stools. Payment in sugar, salt or news.

props.name: Tool shed
props.text: Shovels, a sledge, chain, rope. All counted, all signed out.

props.name: Gate fire
props.text: The gate watch warms its hands here between shifts.

props.name: Market stall
props.text: Batteries, sorted by how much charge someone swears is left in them.

props.name: Scrap pile
props.text: Door panels and bonnets, sorted by size. The wall eats them.

inspect.name: Cold campfire
inspect.text: Two bedrolls round a fire that went out days ago, not years. A tin pot with soup frozen in it. Their tracks head east.

inspect.name: Culvert
inspect.text: A concrete pipe under the road, half choked with ice. Branches and rags have been dragged into the mouth to make a nest. Recently.

inspect.name: Child's backpack
inspect.text: Hung on the guardrail by its straps, the way you leave something for someone to find. Red, with a cartoon cosmonaut on the flap.

inspect.name: Field radio
inspect.text: Strapped into the truck's cab, battery dead. The tuning dial is taped down on one frequency, and someone wrote 'MERIDIAN' on the tape.

inspect.name: A hollow in the snow
inspect.text: Paw prints lead here from the rest stop and circle a hollow scraped out under the billboard. A gnawed paper wrapper, the kind sugar comes in. A dog sleeps here.

stairs.name: Silo 81 portal
stairs.text: Back down the ramp to the surface depot and the lifts.

enemies.speak: A voice from the figure by the car, wet and wrong: 'Close the door. You're letting the warm out.'

folk.name: Woman at the barrel
folk.bark: Warm your hands, Silo. Then tell me how many of you are still down there.

folk.name: Old trader
folk.bark: Salt for news, news for salt. What's the road like?

folk.name: Washerwoman
folk.bark: If you see a grey dog, his name's Kopek. He comes for sugar.

folk.name: Boot seller
folk.bark: Dry boots. Not new, but dry. You'll thank me past the bridge.

folk.name: Mushroom seller
folk.bark: The red jar? Don't ask. Two salt.

folk.name: Gate watch
folk.bark: You came up the road on foot? Then you met them. Keep your voice down in here, people are tired.

folk.name: Goatherd
folk.bark: Three goats, one stove. Touch the goats and we have words.

folk.name: Customer
folk.bark: Rook sets the prices. Mara fixes what breaks. The rest of us wait for spring.

folk.name: Tea drinker
folk.bark: Tea's hot. That's about all I can say for today.

support.msg: A rifle cracks from the gate tower. 'Keep your head down, Silo!'
The second tower joins in. Somebody up there is a good shot.
